verdict.rationale: Docs describe a complete in-PR fix loop: each review comment has a 'Fix with your Agent' button that sends file paths/lines/suggested code to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Devin, a 'Fix All' button for batch fixes, MCP integration to fetch/resolve comments from the IDE, and 'Greplooping' to iteratively fix until a perfect review score—all without leaving the PR context. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming the fix-apply workflow works reliably in practice (community evidence in the pack addresses general review quality/accuracy, not this specific fix-application flow).
